notes.title: OOPS! All Film Festivals! We Will Screen at Dances With Films in Los Angeles!
notes.content:
Oh, hey all!

[b]Would You Call Him a Bad Man?[/b] has been accepted into the prestigious [b]Dances With Films [/b]festival! We will be screening at the famous [b]TCL Chinese Theatres in Los Angeles on June 27th, 2025 at 5 PM [/b]as part of [b]Downbeat[/b], a block of music videos. 

Seems we're [i]not[/i] very good at getting into [i]game[/i] festivals. 

Hrm.

The game's director and singer and the guy who wrote this paragraph will be at the screening to answer questions and give out rare stickers! (It's actually all the same guy. They're not that generous with passes) These stickers have already been tested and found to be compatible with laptops (OS X and up), lamp posts, water bottles (including [b]Stanley Quencher H2.0 and up[/b]), and more!

It's actually none of our business where you want to stick them, but please try not to embarrass us.

Tickets will be available shortly on the festivals official website here: [url=https://danceswithfilms.com/]Dances With Films[/url]

For more frequent updates, please follow along on Instagram here: [url=https://www.instagram.com/ianhinden/]Ian Hinden Instagram[/url]

[b]Thank you so much[/b] for your support on this odd little journey of ours. 

- Ian

notes.title: We're In a Film Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139835/7d36e1465375116d088712a39a091b9e7b3c6e87.png[/img]

Oh, [i]hey[/i]!

[b]Would You Call Him a Bad Man?[/b] has officially been accepted as a selection into this year's [b]Another Hole in the Head Film Festival[/b]!

That means that it will be playing in a [i]real[/i] theater on a [i]real[/i] screen where [i]real[/i] hot dogs are served (Legal note: we are not legally liable for the contents of said hot dogs and "real" is not a guarantee of meat content).

"[b]But how can a game be played at a film festival[/b]," your fingers were just itching to type. It's simple! The screening will be a recording of a play through of the game! That makes this the most successful [b]Let's Play[/b] of all time, as long as you don't consider 10 million views on YouTube and a movie deal to be success. Welp.

The film will be screening in San Francisco on Sunday, December 15th 2024 at 13:20 PM as part of the festival's Shudders collection! We're probably the most pink film in the entire festival, but that's horror for you. It's a genre that is rarely pink. It's just not a scary color, and that's fine. 

Tickets can be purchased at this link [url=https://holehead2024.eventive.org/schedule/shudders-672a858c292d99009b2ec73c/tickets]Eventite Tickets[/url]

Stay tuned for more updates!
